main_measure.name: OLS slope of coin-excess 3-bar forward return on forecast (before costs)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and check passes; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess 3-bar return of deepest third minus shallowest third (< 0 passes)

decided_by: The slope has |t| < 2. No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction +0.608 (below 1), 348 cases (30 needed).
reading: The profile is read from the recorded regime ("unknown" = not vetoed) and the depth from its raw value; cases are grid bars 0,3,6,... of each window with a non-zero forecast and a full 3-bar return in the window, the coin's mean is over all its grid bars in all windows, and the thirds are the floor(n/3) most negative and floor(n/3) least negative forecasts.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +0.608 (below 1), 348 cases (30 needed)
